rules.summary: Deny any call whose authorization basis includes untrusted_content (purpose, identity/delegation, permission, or approval).
In a document_summarization workflow, deny finance.lookup / finance.export calls whose arguments contain document-derived (tainted) content.
Allow finance.export only when actor=finance_analyst AND purpose=finance_reporting AND a human queue approval exists AND arguments are untainted; otherwise deny per missing clause.
